title: Conformal Unlearning: A New Paradigm for Unlearning in Conformal Predictors
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development of 'conformal unlearning' to provide statistical guarantees for machine unlearning (the removal of data influence from models). It uses standard vision and text classification benchmarks to evaluate its algorithm but does not contain any component evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
